   MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  ART IN PUBLIC PLACES COMMITTEE
  March 26, 2024

Chair Le Gaspi called the meeting to order at 5:35 p.m. via Zoom. Responding in person to
roll call were Committee members Apodaca, Juan, and Solis, and committee members Lopez
and Stefenhagen were absent. Theresa Devoy, Staff Liaison and Elizabeth Camarena, Deputy
City Clerk were also present.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Member Apodaca moved and member Juan seconded to approve the revised minutes of
October 24, 2023. MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Members Apodaca, Juan, Solis, and Chair Le Gaspi
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTIONS

Chair and Vice Chair elections were postponed for the next APPC meeting.

REPORTS

Aquatic Center Community Mosaic Project

Ms. Devoy shared that the City has been working with mosaic artist Lindsay Parks who has
completed a project for the City of Downey and a couple projects for Downey Unified School
District. Staff met with the artist at the Aquatic Center and located a space inside the pool area
outside the locker rooms for the mosaic artwork. Ms. Devoy shared the design and dimensions
with the committee and shared that the mosaic art project would involve youth in the community
by having them assist with installing portions of tile alongside the artist. Ms. Devoy informed
the committee that due to the pool operating schedule during the summer, the artist will begin
working on the mural at the site in September 2024 and finishing by October 2024.

Member Juan moved and member Solis seconded to present the Aquatic Center Community
Mosaic Project design to City Council. MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL
VOTE:

AYES:  Members Apodaca, Juan, Solis, and Chair Le Gaspi
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None
 Minutes of the Special Meeting  March 26, 2024
Art in Public Places Commission  Page 2 of 2

Utility Box Art Work Presentations

Ms. Devoy introduced students from Norwalk High School who presented their Utility Box
artwork designs to the committee for approval. The students presented two themes, which
included Nature and Diversity. The boxes would be scheduled for painting in April.

Member Juan moved and member Apodaca seconded to approve the Utility Box Art Work
designs. MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Members Apodaca, Juan, Solis, and Chair Le Gaspi
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

COMMENTS FROM STAFF

Ms. Devoy shared with the committee that other cities typically hire artists to design and paint
utility boxes, however, the City of Norwalk provides the artwork through our local students and
community members. Ms. Devoy suggested to frame past utility boxes that were replaced to
preserve the artwork.

Ms. Devoy also mentioned that Social Services reached out to her requesting the committee
sponsor a mural for their building in celebration of their 50th anniversary. Ms. Devoy will meet
with Social Services to find out the type of artwork they are interested in, and the location of
where they want it to be.

COMMENTS FROM COMMITTEE MEMBERS

Member Apodaca requested an update on the status of the Spirit of Progress horses sculpture
on Hoxie Avenue. She also requested a status on the lighting around the sculpture. Ms. Devoy
informed the committee that she is researching quotes for repairing the sculpture and that
Public Services should be repairing the light fixtures around the sculpture. She also informed
the committee that there were currently no updates on the Newspaper Boy sculpture repairs.

Member Juan requested a status on the art pallet for the Norwalk Cultural Arts Center sign.
Ms. Devoy informed the committee that no one showed interest in the Request for Quotes
process and it would need to be re-advertised with a dollar amount and stipends for the artists.

ADJOURNMENT

The meeting was adjourned at 6:13 p.m.

________________________________
Natalie Le Gaspi, Chair
